messages:
Aisha: quick check-in for AcmeCorp — seeing a spike in errors over the last 24h, can we triage?

Aisha: summary: overall requests +12% day-over-day, errors +4.8pp. Breakout by class: 5xx = 3.6%, timeouts (gateway) = 1.1%, rate-limited (429) = 0.5%.

Aisha: top failing endpoints (by error volume):
- POST /v1/generate (45% of errors)
- POST /v1/chat/stream (22%)
- POST /v1/embeddings (16%)
- GET /v1/health/model (9%)
- POST /v1/rerank (8%)

Aisha: notable patterns: 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream; timeouts mostly on chat streaming route. Rate-limits are small but persistent and correlate with bursty jobs from a single API key.

Ben: looking. pulled recent ingress logs and host metrics. short snippet:
```
2024-03-11T14:02:12Z ingress-gw[gw-3] "POST /v1/generate" 502 0.112s
2024-03-11T14:02:12Z svc-gen[replica-7] connection reset by peer
2024-03-11T14:03:04Z ingress-gw[gw-2] "POST /v1/chat/stream" 504 30.001s
2024-03-11T14:04:10Z rate-limiter key=acct-acme limit=100/s returned=429
```
Ben: early signal looks like two separate things: transient worker crashes causing 502s, and long-tail model inference for streaming hitting the default 30s proxy timeout. rate-limiter is doing what it's configured to do for the bursty key.

Caroline: +1 on worker churn. We rolled out a memory optimization yesterday to a subset of replicas for the generation service — those replicas show OOM kills in k8s events around 14:01.

Caroline: also noticed routing fallback: when the quantized model pool is saturated, requests fall back to larger float model which increases p95 latency and leads to gateway timeouts for streaming.

Ben: proposed immediate mitigations:
- roll back memory-optimized image from replica set rs-gen-blue (quick)
- raise ingress proxy timeout for /v1/chat/stream to 60s (short-term to avoid 504s)
- throttle the offending API key at account layer and ask CS to notify customer to smooth bursts

Caroline: medium-term: add smarter routing to avoid fallback to heavy model when streaming with short timeouts, and increase autoscaler headroom for gen pool.

Aisha: can we assign owners and ETA?

Ben: I'll handle the rollback + patch for ingress timeout, target ETA 30m. (I'll post deploy PR).

Caroline: I'll open an infra ticket for autoscaler tweak + routing rule, ETA EOD.

Aisha: I'll message the customer (acct manager) to request they stagger batch jobs; will also flag renewal risk if this repeats.

DeployBot: deploy starting: rollout rs-gen-blue rollback -> image v1.29.3-prev (by Ben)

Ben: rollback successful on 6/6 pods. 502s down ~85% in last 10m. Still seeing a few 504s for long streaming sessions — increasing timeout now.

Aisha: thanks team. Follow-ups:
- Ben: confirm full error drop and link to dashboard (put in #customer-success ops card)
- Caroline: infra ticket number and recommended autoscaler config
- Aisha: customer comms + note in renewal tracker if we see recurrence

Aisha: marking this as priority until next check-in. :white_check_mark:
